_meta.description: Code-embedding adversarial panel for POST-VERIFY-PLAN.md §4. Catches: (a) syntactic-distance collapse — same shape, different operator/name embedded identically (cosine ≥0.99) means the model is shape-matching not semantically reading; (b) cross-language semantic blindness — Python add ↔ Rust add cosine <0.7 means the multilingual code training failed; (c) code-vs-prose collapse — 'add two numbers' and `def add` indistinguishable (cosine >0.85) OR completely separate (cosine <0.4) is broken in opposite directions; (d) VI-comment domination — adding a Vietnamese docstring to a Python function shifts the embedding more than 15% (cosine <0.85) means natural-language tokens overwhelm code tokens.

prompts.text:
def add(a, b):
    return a + b
prompts.variant:
def sub(a, b):
    return a - b

assertion.rationale: same shape, different operator+name; must distinguish but stay topically close
